title: Reverse Call Tree (who calls this, N-deep)
summary: Builds the tree of callers of a chosen symbol, transitively, to a chosen depth
intro: Read this before changing a routine and you want to know how far the change could ripple back through its callers: it builds the tree of callers to the depth you choose, or the callees with --direction callees.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Reverse Call Tree (who calls this, N-deep)...

surfaces.usage: drag-lint reverse-calltree --qname <X> [--direction callers|callees] [--depth N] [--format text|json|dot|mermaid] [--json] --db PATH [--db ...] (N-deep call tree; callers=who calls X (default), callees=what X calls; cycle-guarded)
